name: control_prefix
summary: Control prefix. The next byte is looked up in two switch tables of 0x108675a0 (0x108675d4 for 0x00..0x06 and 0x10867cdc for 0xf6..0xff, plus the explicit 0xf5 case). A listed selector runs the control command documented in opcodes-ff.json and consumes one byte; any other selector is handed back to the interpreter and runs as an ordinary opcode, so the prefix itself only advances one byte.

operands.meaning: for any other selector: the opcode re-dispatched by the interpreter

control_flow: returns either the cursor selected by the control command or, for an unlisted selector, the selector byte itself (1-byte prefix)
